4. Constitution of DAC and Appellate
The Vice Chancellor will, nominate the DAC which shall consist of
a. Any Officer of the University - Chairman
b. Four Faculty - Members
c. One student from each school - Members
(at least O01 male & O1 female student)
d. Assistant Registrar - Member Secretary
The quorum will be 04 members.
The President will nominate the Appellate Committee, which shall consist of:
a. Vice Chancellor/Pro-Vice Chancellor - Chairperson
b. Dean of each School - Members
c. Registrar - Member
d. Two Faculty members - Member
e. Deputy Registrar - Convener
No member of DAC will form part of the Appellate Committee.
The quorum will be O03 members.
